description:
## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **FirebaseCrashlytics: closed two independent bypasses of the collection-disable patch.** A shipped-artifact dex scan on `com.avito.android` and `ru.sberbankmobile` found that the existing patch only neutralized `setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(boolean)`, leaving two other live paths able to transmit crash/log/custom-key/user-ID data:
  - `sendUnsentReports()` is a documented, Firebase-sanctioned bypass of the collection-enabled flag ("Use sendUnsentReports to upload existing reports even when automatic data collection is disabled") and was never touched.
  - `setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled` has a second, independent public overload taking a boxed Kotlin `Boolean?` (`Ljava/lang/Boolean;`), confirmed live via `dexdump` disassembly on the shipped artifacts (not a compiler bridge/synthetic - both overloads forward to the same internal setter). The existing fingerprint only matched the primitive `(Z)` overload.

  Both are now neutralized alongside the existing setter. Verified by rebuilding Avito and Sberbank from fresh originals and confirming via `dexdump -d` that all three targeted methods are `return-void` in the shipped bytecode.

All 10 apps re-scanned at both dex and manifest level against this release: 0 findings.

## Verification note (added after initial publication)

At the moment this release was first published, only com.avito.android and ru.sberbankmobile had actually been rebuilt and re-scanned against this exact .mpp. This has since been corrected: all 10 apps were rebuilt fresh against this release and re-scanned, and findings for two of them (Ozon's manifest kill-switches, VK Video's OpenTelemetry gate and MyTarget components) were additionally cross-checked by hand with raw aapt2/dexdump output, independent of the repo's own Python scanner. All checks pass.
